verdict: No paid activity this period; organic reach is softening and needs attention.
narrative: This period, your practice ran with zero paid advertising across both Meta and Google Ads, which means all incoming activity came exclusively from your Google Business Profile and organic Instagram. GBP delivered 97 total actions — 21 calls, 30 direction requests, and 46 website clicks — but those numbers have slowed, with GBP actions down 22% and Instagram reach down 29% in just the last seven days. With no paid channel running, there is no lever to offset that organic softening. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore a consistent lead flow, and you should expect pipeline activity to resume as those campaigns ramp up.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions this period (calls, directions, and web clicks)

watch_item.issue: GBP and Instagram organic reach are both declining week-over-week with no paid activity to compensate, leaving the practice with no active lead intake.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaigns are being reactivated this week to restore a reliable lead channel while organic visibility stabilizes.
